Before you visit

A little clarity.
An easier visit.

Have another question? The hospital can help you with service availability and appointment enquiries.

Follow hospital updates on Instagram
How do I enquire about an appointment?

Call +91 8757731665 to confirm doctor availability and appointment timings. A website click does not confirm a booking.

What is the consultation fee?

Consultation starts at ₹500. The fee may vary by doctor or service; confirm the applicable fee with the hospital.

Where is the hospital located?

The hospital is at Ratu Road Chowk, Ranchi, Jharkhand. Use the Google listing link for directions.

How can I confirm diagnostic tests and charges?

Call the hospital before your visit to confirm the test, timing, preparation and charges.

How do I contact emergency care?

24×7 emergency care is advertised by the hospital. Call +91 8757731665 directly for assistance.

Can I book an appointment online?

Yes. Choose a doctor, date and time on the booking page and send the request on WhatsApp. The hospital calls to confirm; your request is not final until then.

Do you accept health insurance or Ayushman Bharat?

See the insurance list on the Patients & visitors page, and call before admission to confirm your insurer or scheme.

Let’s plan your next step.

Call to confirm doctor availability, consultation fees and appointment timings, or book online and we’ll call you back.
